name: Design Safe Programmatic SEO
summary: Design data-backed templated pages with unique utility, quality gates, and controlled indexing.
description: Design or audit a programmatic SEO system using reliable data, a real repeated user job, differentiated page value, template quality, indexing controls, and lifecycle ownership. Use before generating many search landing pages.
refuses: It does not create doorway pages, spun text, fake locations, fabricated data, or mass near-duplicates.
It does not bypass robots, access restrictions, content licenses, or platform terms.
It does not promise rankings or indexation from page volume.
